samples.name: Headless reel · First 24 hours
samples.hook: Crashes happen on the I-10 and Loop 101 every day — what you do in the first 24 hours decides what your claim is worth.

script.line: See a doctor today — even if you feel fine. Adrenaline hides injuries.
Photograph everything: the cars, the scene, the other plate.
Hold off on a recorded statement to their insurer.

samples.cta: Hurt on a Phoenix road? Free review.
samples.note: Faceless — no filming. Captions + motion only, in your brand colors.

samples.name: Carousel · 5 mistakes that hurt your claim

slides.heading: 5 mistakes that quietly hurt your injury claim
slides.body: Most people make two of these in the first week. Swipe.

slides.heading: 1. Waiting to get treated
slides.body: A gap in treatment becomes the argument that you weren't really hurt.

slides.heading: 2. Posting about it
slides.body: An 'I'm okay!' post gets screenshotted and used against you later.

slides.heading: 3. Taking the first offer
slides.body: It's a starting point, not a fair number. Once you sign, it's done.

slides.heading: Save this for someone who'll need it

samples.name: Carousel · How we build your case

slides.heading: How we actually build your case
slides.body: No dollar promises — just the work. Swipe.

slides.heading: We move fast on evidence
slides.body: On I-10, dashcam and vehicle data get overwritten in days. We preserve it immediately.

slides.heading: We find every responsible party
slides.body: Rarely just one driver — other parties can share fault.

slides.heading: We prepare like it's going to trial
slides.body: Cases resolve higher when the other side knows you're ready.
